title: Deeper/broader current DXF consumer and candidate-admission refresh
method: Primary-source repository/documentation review plus local source-owner search. No peer was cloned, installed, or executed. No drawings or fixtures were downloaded.

evidence: Current README describes the application as a 2D CAD consumer.
Current README identifies its Swift DXF module as a port of libdxfrw.
Current README documents ODA FileConverter for DWG import/export.
README advertises DXF R2007 round-trip and calls out group-440 transparency, SPLINE weights, HATCH gradients, and ATTRIB/ATTDEF.
sources.evidence_ceiling: App-level DXF consumption or rendering only; not an independent DXF codec vote, DWG parser result, or 3D semantic witness.
sources.plan_action: Add a conditional direct-DXF consumer smoke procedure; do not schedule it in routine validation or count it as independent parser/writer evidence.

evidence: README advertises a lossless, resource-bounded ASCII/Binary DXF core.
The same README states that visible source is under a proprietary license and does not grant permission to use, copy, modify, or redistribute it.
Repository page showed no release artifact at review time.
sources.plan_action: Exclude from open-source comparator, test-corpus, code-port, and dependency consideration unless licensing and provenance change.

evidence: Current README matrix marks DXF writing unavailable for AC1009 and AC1012.
Current README matrix marks DWG writing unavailable for AC1021.
Generic project read/write descriptions therefore must not substitute for direction/version-specific route admission.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Only exact implemented version/direction/entity routes; not a format authority or local defect report.
sources.plan_action: Strengthen comparator admission metadata and preserve existing per-record loss accounting.
